agent: foreign minister whole, collecting session: every engine method ForeignMinister_Tick reaches that was unread (OpenHOI3 stage 5, 2026-10-16)
question: What the minister's Propose, ProposeWar, ClearWarProposal and PercOccupied do, what the country, status, war and strategy methods the tick's scripts call answer, and what the minister's constructor starts with.

addresses.name: CAIForeignMinister::Propose
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CAIForeignMinister::Propose(CAIForeignMinister* this, CDiplomaticAction* action, float score)
addresses.comment: Lua `minister:Propose(action, score)`: where score is **strictly above** the cached score (+0x5C) and the action's slot 14 IsSelectable holds, the cached action (+0x58) is deleted, the action is cloned (slot 16) into +0x58 and +0x5C = score. Otherwise nothing. DoWork posts the cache after the Lua when its score is above 50.0 and then sets the score to -1.0f; a cached action at 50 or under is neither posted nor cleared, so it stays until a higher one replaces it. The constructor starts the score at 0.0f. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-foreignminister.md, section I.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole and `ret 8` at VA 0x89DD45; luabind registration (CAIForeignMinister::Propose, void(CDiplomaticAction&, float)). The slot-14 call is through the action's vftable.

addresses.name: CAIForeignMinister::ProposeWar
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CAIForeignMinister::ProposeWar(CAIForeignMinister* this, CCountryTag target, float score)
addresses.comment: Lua `minister:ProposeWar(tag, score)`: where score > the proposed war's score (+0x6C) + 40.0 (the double at VA 0x160A2F8), +0x64/+0x68 = the tag and +0x6C = score. Read by GetProposedWarTarget (+0x64) and nothing else found; no shipped script calls any of the three. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-foreignminister.md, section I.
addresses.evidence: Listing VA 0x89E420..0x89E453 `ret 0xc`: `movss xmm2,[ecx+0x6c]; cvtps2pd; addsd [0x160a2f8]; comisd; jbe` then the three stores. 0x160A2F8 reads 40.0 as a double.

addresses.name: CAIForeignMinister::ClearWarProposal
addresses.comment: Lua `minister:ClearWarProposal()`: the proposed war's tag back to `---`/0 and its score (+0x6C) to 0. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-foreignminister.md, section I.

addresses.name: CAIForeignMinister::PercOccupied
addresses.comment: Lua `minister:PercOccupied(tag)`: 0 where the country owns no province; else over its owned provinces (OwnedProvinces), counting each it owns and adding 1.0f (VA 0x171DBAC, truncated back to an int each time) for each it does not control, `occupied x 100.0 / owned` in double precision, made a float and rounded to the nearest by `fistp`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-foreignminister.md, section I.
addresses.evidence: Listing VA 0x89E280..0x89E410 `ret 4` (an early `ret 4` at 0x89E2D9 for no province): `addss [0x171dbac]; cvttss2si` at 0x89E3AB, `mulsd [0x160a358]` (100.0), `divsd`, `cvtsd2ss`, `fld; fistp` at 0x89E3F3.

addresses.name: CCountry::IsGivingLendLeaseToTarget
addresses.comment: Lua `country:IsGivingLendLeaseToTarget(tag)`: whether this country's lend-lease distributions have an entry for that receiver. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-foreignminister.md, section I.

addresses.name: CDiplomaticAction::IsSelectable
addresses.comment: **Slot 14, the base's own body**: actor id != recipient id. Every kind overrides it with its own rules; Lua's `action:IsSelectable()` reaches the override, luabind registering a vcall thunk for slot 14 (luabind.json `vcall_thunk`), not this body. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-foreignminister.md, section I; FINDINGS-diploaction.md.
addresses.evidence: Three instructions at VA 0xA0EAE0; vtable.py --holding: CDiplomaticAction slot 14 only. luabind.json records the registration's pointer as the thunk 0xA788D0 with vtable_slot 14.

addresses.name: CAIForeignMinister::CAIForeignMinister
addresses.comment: Bare `ret`; both operands are registers - `this` in EAX (handed straight to CAIAgent::CAIAgent, which also takes EAX) and the owner in ESI. Pushes `[owner+0x24]` and `[owner+0x20]`, writes vftable 0x15EB97C, `+0x54 = owner`, `+0x58 = 0` (the cached proposal), `+0x5C = 0.0f` (its score), `+0x60 = -1`, `+0x64 = 0x2D2D2D` and `+0x68 = 0` (the proposed war's tag), `+0x6C = 0.0f` (its score), and **`+0x70 = 1`, the skip-once byte DoWork clears and stops on - so a new foreign minister's first work does nothing**. The object is 0x74 bytes and lands at CEU3AI+0x60. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ai.md and FINDINGS-foreignminister.md, section I.
addresses.evidence: Revised: the old comment stopped at +0x64. Listing VA 0x89D2E0..0x89D32F: `mov [eax+0x68],ecx` (0), `movss [eax+0x6c],xmm0` (0.0), `mov byte [eax+0x70],1` at 0x89D328, then `ret`.
